shortDescription: Determine invoice eligibility from frozen terms and evidence, then derive a bounded payable basis with deterministic integer arithmetic.
detailedDescription: InvoiceBasis creates a consent-bound invoice case with immutable eligibility terms, bounded gross minor units and a fixed rational rate. A distinct designated attestor wallet signs the evidence digest. GenLayer validators independently assess invoice class, exclusions and evidence sufficiency; the contract calculates the provisional payable basis using integer floor division and never transfers funds. Challenges and second-round deliberation precede finalization.
problemSolved: Invoice eligibility can be semantically ambiguous while payment arithmetic, rates and rounding must remain fixed and reproducible.
whyGenLayer: Semantic consensus evaluates the meaning of frozen eligibility terms and evidence. Deterministic code alone cannot decide a nuanced invoice-class or exclusion question. Amount, rate, actors and rules remain contract-controlled.
semanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify the exact eligibility vector in gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe. Strict vector validation and validator rerun are required; disagreement aborts adjudication. Deterministic code derives ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED and provisional payable amount.
reviewInstructions: Inspect contracts/invoicebasis.py and evidence/invoicebasis-live.json for GLV4-invoicebasis-39138804500. The recorded terminal result is REVIEW_REQUIRED. Do not replace it with a positive result. This is a standalone contract with no app URL.
knownLimitations: An attestor signature proves control of the designated wallet, not issuer identity, invoice origin or source-record truth. Amounts are determinations only; the contract does not escrow or transfer funds. Live qualification references use synthetic source data.
